title: Encapsulation and Constructors
goal: Enforce invariants by hiding struct fields behind constructor functions.

sections.text: You hide implementation details inside a module by keeping struct fields private.

sections.caption: Private field `count` cannot be modified directly from outside.

sections.text: Outside code cannot construct a struct directly using literal syntax if any field is private.

sections.code:
// Fails outside module:
// let c = Counter { count: 5 };
sections.caption: Direct struct literal instantiation fails when fields are private.

sections.text: Provide public constructor functions like `new` or methods to safely expose and modify internal state.

explanation: Enforce invariants by hiding struct fields behind constructor functions.
